PARAMS = {"kp_eff": 1.0, "kv_eff": 0.1, "n_sub": 5, "grasp_thresh": 0.3, "grasp_x_off": 0.0, "grasp_y_off": 0.0, "grasp_z_off": 0.0}

def step(state, action, p, meta):
    s = state
    a = action
    ns = {}
    ns["goal.x"] = s["goal.x"]
    ns["goal.y"] = s["goal.y"]
    ns["goal.z"] = s["goal.z"]
    
    # Substep Integration for Effector
    # Internal velocity resets each step (models acceleration from command)
    ex, ey, ez = s["effector.x"], s["effector.y"], s["effector.z"]
    tx, ty, tz = a[0], a[1], a[2]
    
    vx, vy, vz = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    dt = 1.0 / p["n_sub"]
    
    for _ in range(int(p["n_sub"])):
        # PD Law
        ax = p["kp_eff"] * (tx - ex) - p["kv_eff"] * vx
        ay = p["kp_eff"] * (ty - ey) - p["kv_eff"] * vy
        az = p["kp_eff"] * (tz - ez) - p["kv_eff"] * vz
        
        vx += ax * dt
        vy += ay * dt
        vz += az * dt
        
        ex += vx * dt
        ey += vy * dt
        ez += vz * dt
        
    ns["effector.x"] = ex
    ns["effector.y"] = ey
    ns["effector.z"] = ez
    
    # Binary Grasp
    if a[4] > p["grasp_thresh"]:
        ns["block.x"] = ns["effector.x"] + p["grasp_x_off"]
        ns["block.y"] = ns["effector.y"] + p["grasp_y_off"]
        ns["block.z"] = ns["effector.z"] + p["grasp_z_off"]
    else:
        ns["block.x"] = s["block.x"]
        ns["block.y"] = s["block.y"]
        ns["block.z"] = s["block.z"]
        
    return ns

def step(state, action, p, meta):
    import math
    s = state
    a = action
    ns = {}
    ns["goal.x"] = s["goal.x"]
    ns["goal.y"] = s["goal.y"]
    ns["goal.z"] = s["goal.z"]
    
    # PD Tracking with substeps for each axis
    def pd_track(pos, cmd, scale, kp, dt, n):
        target = pos + cmd * scale
        vel = 0.0

            acc = kp * (target - pos)
            vel += acc * dt
            pos += vel * dt
        return pos

    ns["effector.x"] = pd_track(s["effector.x"], a[0], p["eff_scale"], p["eff_kp"], p["eff_dt"], int(p["eff_substeps"]))

    if a[4] > p["grasp_thresh"]:
        # Rigid attachment with offset

        ns["block.y"] = ns["effector.y"] + p["grasp_y_off"]

# MECHANISM: Effector X gain depends on Z height (simulating arm Jacobian kinematics); Block is rigidly attached when grasped.
PARAMS = {"eff_gain_x_base": 0.15, "eff_gain_x_z_dep": 0.1, "eff_gain_y": 0.11, "eff_gain_z": 0.10, "grasp_thresh": 0.3, "grasp_x_off": 0.01, "grasp_y_off": 0.0, "grasp_z_off": -0.02}

def step(state, action, p, meta):
    import math
    s = state
    a = action
    ns = {}
    ns["goal.x"] = s["goal.x"]
    ns["goal.y"] = s["goal.y"]
    ns["goal.z"] = s["goal.z"]
    
    # Z-dependent gain for X movement
    current_gain_x = p["eff_gain_x_base"] + p["eff_gain_x_z_dep"] * s["effector.z"]
    dx = a[0] * current_gain_x
    dy = a[1] * p["eff_gain_y"]
    dz = a[2] * p["eff_gain_z"]
    
    ns["effector.x"] = s["effector.x"] + dx
    ns["effector.y"] = s["effector.y"] + dy
    ns["effector.z"] = s["effector.z"] + dz
    
    if a[4] > p["grasp_thresh"]:
        ns["block.x"] = ns["effector.x"] + p["grasp_x_off"]
        ns["block.y"] = ns["effector.y"] + p["grasp_y_off"]
        ns["block.z"] = ns["effector.z"] + p["grasp_z_off"]
    else:
        ns["block.x"] = s["block.x"]
        ns["block.y"] = s["block.y"]
        ns["block.z"] = s["block.z"]
    return ns
